question: The number of live births per thousand persons in a year is called _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birth rate.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birth rate** refers to the number of live births per** 1,000 people **in a given year. 
 
• **It is an important demographic indicator that helps measure the growth and health of a population.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fertility rate refers to the number of live births per 1,000 women of reproductive age (usually between 15 to 49 years) in a given year.**
 
• **Crude rate** is a term used to describe any rate that is calculated for an entire population, without any adjustments made for **age, sex, or other factors.**
 
• **Death rate** refers to the number of deaths per** 1,000 people **in a given year.
